facts.value: If you wish to develop your knowledge of business while learning about the influence of politics, law, history and sociology on business decisions, then this programme might be for you. While other business programmes contain an international perspective, this programme provides an extensive international context that will drive your understanding and creativity.

value: Enjoy a programme that puts business in an international framework

facts.value: The BA in International Business will provide you with a distinctive and challenging undergraduate experience.
